newsitem.title: USA: National Surgery off on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: National Surgery off on profit-taking.

text.p: National Surgery Centers Inc was off 3 to 35-1/2 in thin trading on profit taking after a sharp run-up Friday, analysts said.
"Operationally, the company appears sound ... It probably is just hitting some price targets," said First Dallas Securities analyst Eric Boyce.

The Chicago-based company said it was unaware of any fundamental reason for the dip. "We had a surprising spike Friday. I guess it was up 5 or 6 ...Our expectation was for some settling today," said chief executive Timothy Geary.
The company operates ambulatory surgery centers. Its shares have swung from the high 30s in December to the mid-20s in April and back to the high 30s last week.
Volume on Monday was only 35,700 shares.
